title: Development of a DICT Learning Model with Differentiated Digital Modules to Enhance Creative Thinking, Learner Independence, and Technology Integration in Prospective Elementary Teachers
reason: Quasi-experiment comparing DICT and control classes on a creative-thinking test, SRL questionnaire and TPACK scale. LMS engagement metric and selected-material complexity appear only in density plots against creative scores, with no statistic reported.

extraction.design: R&D (Plomp) with quasi-experimental EG/CG comparison and within-group ablation
extraction.population: prospective elementary teachers (PGSD), physics concepts course
extraction.lms_indicators: LMS engagement metric E_obs (threshold-based), complexity of learning-object materials selected (shown graphically only)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: creative thinking test, SRL questionnaire (learner independence), TPACK technology integration
extraction.notes: Borderline: Fig. 3 hexbin (LOM complexity vs creative synthesis score) and Fig. 4 (low-engagement subgroup density) relate platform measures to outcomes only visually; no coefficient or test. Group effects d=1.03-1.31 are EG vs CG. Affiliation inconsistency (Universitas Negeri Medan authors; implementation 'at Almuslim University').
